triadic_descent.CIF: E opens the source-owned three-species possibility basis [n,p,d] and the two ordered reversible reaction channels fixed by the E stoichiometric program.
triadic_descent.QV: The inherited recursive kernel weights the ordered forward/reverse reaction channels by its first two normalized modal weights; mass-action flow selects the unique positivity-preserving equilibrium and recursively compresses residual disequilibrium.
triadic_descent.RFL: The stabilized isotope-abundance state, additive conservation ledgers, freeze-out witness, delta-envelope uncertainty state, restart record and H_E_to_F are retained as downstream memory.

species_and_graph.semantics: RFC Module-E internal primordial species labels in the exact E program order; no empirical Standard Model/nuclear correspondence is claimed at MINIMAL_SPINE.
species_and_graph.ordered_parent_map: D final_population indices 0,1,2 map index-preservingly to E program species n,p,d.
species_and_graph.energy_interpretation: Internal parent-gap-scaled additive carrier energy E_i=g_C*A_i; this is conserved exactly by E stoichiometry. No dimensionful nuclear binding energy is claimed.

rate_law.canonical_kernel_expression: w_j=delta^-j at the E reaction-clock origin; normalize over the two exact ordered E reaction channels.
rate_law.units: inverse intrinsic E reaction-clock unit after kf+kr=1 gauge fixing
rate_law.uniqueness_statement: For the exact two ordered E reaction channels, canonical kernel ordering and the intrinsic-clock normalization kf+kr=1 uniquely fix kf and kr. No observational or historical abundance coefficient enters.

equilibrium.selection_rule: unique root on the positivity-preserving stoichiometric interval [-d0,min(n0,p0)]

freeze_out.witness: first state on the monotone physical extent branch satisfying |x_eq-x|/|x_eq-x0| <= q_E
freeze_out.interpretation: QV has compressed the remaining reaction disequilibrium to the canonical recursive closure-depth factor; RFL stores the resulting abundance state.

execution.max_step_definition: t_freeze/128, inheriting the immediately-parent D baseline resolution convention

uncertainty.rule: For each frozen delta member, inherit its D final_at_one_gap_efold state, rederive kf, kr, equilibrium, freeze witness and final E state with no retuning; report componentwise envelope and diagnostic covariance separately from stochastic covariance.

network_size_rule: The E source graph has exactly two ordered reaction channels. N=1 forward-only and reverse-only truncations are mandatory withheld-reaction ablations; N=2 is the source-complete minimal-spine network. No unsupported third reaction may be added for a cosmetic size sequence.
countermodels: SCALAR_COLLAPSE: replace ordered kernel weights by kf=kr=1/2
CHANNEL_SWAP: exchange the two canonical kernel weights
gates: withheld reaction and independent implementation checks
falsifiers: any historical/public abundance target enters generation
kf/kr differs from inherited delta above 1e-12
BDF refinement changes final state above 1e-8 L_infinity
independent extent reconstruction differs above 1e-8 L_infinity
full two-channel network is not distinguishable from scalar-collapse or withheld-channel countermodels
independent_verifier_design: Reconstruct delta and nClosure from H_A_to_B ancestry, reconstruct kf/kr from the first two normalized kernel weights, inherit the exact D final population, solve the one-dimensional reaction-extent Riccati equation independently, derive the unique feasible equilibrium and q_E freeze witness, then compare against primary solver outputs without trusting primary gate summaries.
claim_boundary: Module E may establish an internally generated RFC minimal-spine primordial three-species reaction state, source-owned two-channel rate law, conserved baryon/charge/internal-energy ledgers, freeze-out witness and inherited uncertainty envelope. It does not establish calibrated nuclear reaction rates, MeV binding energies, SI time, Standard Model isotope correspondence, or empirical abundance agreement.
